en: Grunt!\pI am the KARATE MASTER!\nI am the LEADER here!\pYou wish to challenge us?\nExpect no mercy!\pFwaaa!
Indeed, I have lost!\pBut, I beseech you, do not take\nour emblem as your trophy!\pIn return, I will give you a prized\nFIGHTING POKéMON!\pChoose whichever one you like!
Grunt!\nStay and train at karate with us!
You wait 'til you see our MASTER!\nI'm a small fry compared to him!
Our MASTER is a pro fighter.\nBe prepared to lose!
Hiyah!\nI have no fear for anything tough!\pI shatter boulders for training\nevery day!
The only thing that frightens us is\npsychic power!
The prime fighters across the land\ntrain here.
